description: Returns where this workspace stands on texting: the status of its own toll-free number registration (none, draft, submitted, in_review, rejected or verified), the number, when it was submitted, the saved form (registration number masked), the checklist the business must meet, the latest website check results, and, after a rejection, a plain explanation with fix steps. Free and read only. Carriers only deliver marketing texts from a toll-free number verified under the business itself, which takes 1 to 2 weeks and sometimes up to a month: never promise a date. Use it to walk the person through the checklist item by item (privacy policy sentence, optional standalone opt-in, sample messages starting with the brand and ending "Reply STOP to opt out"). With the account scope you can fill and fix the form (sms_registration_update), run the checks (sms_website_check) and submit after a yes (sms_registration_submit); the registration number is always entered in the dashboard at setup_url. Text campaigns cannot be scheduled until status is verified. Requires API key scope: read.
name: sms_setup_status
title: Text messaging setup
